title: Beatrix and the Atlas
author: Jude Vasquez
blurb: Orsen Okafor, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
